verdict.rationale: A government business-filing portal could plausibly offer API access, so this axis applies. The evidence shows no API and no way to issue credentials. 'User Access' only lets an entity control which human users may submit online filings, and its stated purpose is to prevent unauthorized submissions. Probes found no OpenAPI spec, and the bizfile portal sits behind bot management, so there is no evidence of scoped or least-privilege credentials for an agent.
